answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fakes: each epoch auctions work slots, not a free haven for new names. An applicant bids twice its 30-day earnings for one vertex in the allocation graph. Bids from one source are merged on a crystal-clear list, so splitting a wallet buys no extra slot. Running 100 fakes costs 100 bids, 200 months of earnings, far above any reward. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full, undiluted share.
